# Design

src/recap.c. Discovery maps the root to Claude Code's project directory name and walks ~/.codex/sessions reading each rollout's first record. Parsing is line by line with the json.c readers. The decision call is jev_ask_at, the Jev client pointed at another key, model and endpoint, so request building, private-config curl, retries and jev.log are shared; the endpoint bills each question against the whole state, so chunks are six statements and forked workers fill the per-chunk cache in parallel before the parent's own pass reads it. The writer is chat_model_ask, the changelog's gateway call made public. No new dependency.
